description: This file defines the AWSChatBedrock class implementing an AWS Bedrock chat model node, including its configuration, initialization, and methods for listing models and regions. It integrates with AWS Bedrock via the @langchain/aws package and exports the class for use in a larger application.

classes.name: AWSChatBedrock_ChatModels
classes.description: A class representing an AWS Bedrock chat model node, including configuration, loading methods, and initialization logic.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains asynchronous methods to list available models and regions for the AWS Bedrock chat models.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AWS Bedrock chat model node with provided configuration, credentials, and options, returning an instance of BedrockChat.
